title: UAAP: FEU women overwhelm UP in ill-tempered clash
summary: Judie Arevalo grabbed a brace to power Far Eastern University past the University of the Philippines, 4-0, but their UAAP Season 89 showdown was marred by a near-fracas that featured six red cards.
